title: Keep only one genre
prompt: Show the title and genre of every Fiction book. Replace the ___ with the right value.
hints: Text values go in single quotes, and capital letters must match: 'Fiction'.

cases.name: A different catalogue
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM books; INSERT INTO books VALUES (20, 'Ember Bay', 'Ann Cho', 'Fiction', 11.0, 150, 2017), (21, 'Long Tide', 'Sol Ruiz', 'Poetry', 14.0, 90, 2019), (22, 'Old Maps', 'Ken Ito', 'Fiction', 16.0, 205, 2020);

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title, genre FROM books WHERE genre = 'fiction';
SELECT title, genre FROM books;
SELECT title, genre FROM books WHERE genre <> 'Fiction';

title: Under a price limit
prompt: Show the title and price of books that cost less than 15. A book costing exactly 15 shouldn't appear.
hints: Numbers don't need quotes. Use the < operator.

cases.name: A book priced exactly at the limit
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM books; INSERT INTO books VALUES (20, 'Ember Bay', 'Ann Cho', 'Fiction', 11.0, 150, 2017), (23, 'Even Keel', 'Ann Cho', 'Poetry', 15.0, 100, 2021), (22, 'Old Maps', 'Ken Ito', 'Fiction', 16.0, 205, 2020);

solutions: SELECT title, price FROM books WHERE price < 15;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title, price FROM books WHERE price <= 15;
SELECT title, price FROM books WHERE price > 15;

title: Everything except one
prompt: Show the title and genre of every book that isn't in the Science genre.

cases.name: A different catalogue
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM books; INSERT INTO books VALUES (12, 'Sky Atlas', 'Ada Hill', 'Science', 25.0, 300, 2023), (21, 'Long Tide', 'Sol Ruiz', 'Poetry', 14.0, 90, 2019);

solutions: SELECT title, genre FROM books WHERE genre <> 'Science';
SELECT title, genre FROM books WHERE genre != 'Science';

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title, genre FROM books WHERE genre = 'Science';
SELECT title, genre FROM books WHERE genre <> 'science';
wrongSolutions.why: The lowercase value matches nothing, so no book is removed

title: Tough climbs
prompt: The hiking club calls a trail tough if it climbs at least 870 metres. Show the name and elevation_m of the tough trails.
hints: At least includes the value itself, so use >=.

cases.name: Different trails
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM trails; INSERT INTO trails VALUES (7, 'Birch Walk', 'West', 3.1, 40), (8, 'High Moor', 'East', 12.6, 610), (9, 'Crag Top', 'West', 9.9, 900);

solutions: SELECT name, elevation_m FROM trails WHERE elevation_m >= 870;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name, elevation_m FROM trails WHERE elevation_m > 870;
wrongSolutions.why: Leaves out a trail of exactly 870 metres

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name, elevation_m FROM trails WHERE length_km >= 870;

title: When nothing matches
prompt: Show the title and year of books published in 2020. If no book matches, the correct result is an empty table, so don't try to force a row.
hints: An empty result is a valid answer. Filter on the exact year.

cases.name: A catalogue with a match
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM books; INSERT INTO books VALUES (10, 'Copper Moon', 'Ada Hill', 'Fantasy', 20.0, 100, 2020), (11, 'North Light', 'Raj Dev', 'Travel', 7.5, 180, 2015);

solutions: SELECT title, year FROM books WHERE year = 2020;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title, year FROM books WHERE year > 2020;
SELECT title, year FROM books WHERE year = 2021;
SELECT title, year FROM books WHERE year = 1999;
wrongSolutions.why: Returns an empty table every time, without checking for 2020

title: Fix the comparison
prompt: This query should show the title of books that cost more than 20, but it fails. Fix it.
hints: Read the error, then look closely at the comparison operator.

cases.name: A book priced exactly at the limit
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM books; INSERT INTO books VALUES (10, 'Copper Moon', 'Ada Hill', 'Fantasy', 20.0, 100, 2020), (12, 'Sky Atlas', 'Ada Hill', 'Science', 25.0, 300, 2023);

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title FROM books WHERE price >= 20;
SELECT title FROM books WHERE price = 20;

title: Compare two columns
prompt: A book counts as a bargain when its pages are greater than 20 times its price. Show the title of each bargain as bargain_book.
hints: WHERE can compare a column with a calculation: pages > price * 20.

cases.name: A different catalogue
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM books; INSERT INTO books VALUES (10, 'Copper Moon', 'Ada Hill', 'Fantasy', 20.0, 100, 2020), (11, 'North Light', 'Raj Dev', 'Travel', 7.5, 180, 2015);

solutions: SELECT title AS bargain_book FROM books WHERE pages > price * 20;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title AS bargain_book FROM books WHERE pages < price * 20;
SELECT title AS bargain_book FROM books WHERE pages > price;
SELECT title FROM books WHERE pages > price * 20;

title: An author sale
prompt: The shop is taking 2 off every Mina Rao book. Show each of her books' titles as book, and the reduced price as sale_price.
hints: Filter with WHERE, and calculate the new price in SELECT.

cases.name: A different catalogue
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM books; INSERT INTO books VALUES (30, 'Tin Sky', 'Mina Rao', 'Poetry', 5.0, 50, 2010), (31, 'Ash Garden', 'Ann Cho', 'Fiction', 9.0, 120, 2012);

solutions: SELECT title AS book, price - 2 AS sale_price FROM books WHERE author = 'Mina Rao';

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title AS book, price AS sale_price FROM books WHERE author = 'Mina Rao';
SELECT title AS book, price - 2 AS sale_price FROM books WHERE author = 'Mina';
wrongSolutions.why: The author's full name must match

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title AS book, price - 2 AS sale_price FROM books;
